sentences.text: Dagasuchus santacruzensis is known from a partial hip made of one ilium and two ischia.
This hip structure closely resembles that of other early loricatans like Stagonosuchus and Saurosuchus.
Dagasuchus is classified as an early member of the evolutionary group Loricata, which contains modern crocodilians and their ancestors.
It lived between 237 and 227.3 million years ago in the Late Triassic (Carnian) period of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
